properties.name: Feature: BRP Effects
properties.author: Kerry Harrison (sirkerry)
properties.description: Adds five effect keywords - CHECK, ATK, DMG, INIT, and ARMOR - covering Skill/Characteristic/Power checks, Attack rolls, Damage rolls, Initiative, and target-side damage reduction. Stock Basic Roleplaying has zero EffectManager usage anywhere in its own code - this wires up the first pieces of CoreRPG's Effects system to BRP mechanics.
